If you’re visiting Ho Chi Minh City and want to experience local and local cuisine, Cocotte is a great choice! The restaurant is hidden in the streets near the town hall, in a warm atmosphere and filled with the relaxation of the French cottage.
The sealed Duck Confit is delicate, soft and juicy in the flesh; Duck breast and French sauce also perform very well, and it is impressed with special-tuned sauce. The meal portion is solid and the price is very easy to approach, the attitude of service is warm and attentive. Whether it's a couple date or a friend's dinner, it's a food experience not to be missed in Ho Chi Minh City!

A Little Taste of France in the Heart of the City
May 2026 • Couples
Last night we stumbled upon this place almost by accident, and within minutes it felt like we had been transported to a cozy little French bistro hidden somewhere in the streets of Provence. The warm lights, rustic brick walls, the clinking wine glasses, and the intimate atmosphere created something truly special from the moment we walked in.

And the food… absolutely magical. Every dish felt carefully crafted with passion and attention to detail. Cocotte | Ho Chi Minh VN
Oct 2024 • Family
Cocette in Ho Chi Minh offers a charming dining experience with a cozy, inviting atmosphere. The menu features a mix of French-inspired dishes with a modern twist.

I started with the truffle fries, which were crispy and flavorful, with a perfect touch of truffle oil. For the main course, I had the grilled chicken, which was tender and juicy, served with a side of well-seasoned vegetables and a light, tangy sauce. The creamy mashed potatoes that accompanied the dish were rich and smooth.

For dessert, I tried the chocolate fondant, and it was indulgent – warm, gooey, and just the right amount of sweetness.

The service was friendly and attentive, adding to the overall pleasant experience. Cocette is a great spot for anyone craving a delicious, well-crafted meal in a relaxed setting. Highly recommend!
